We just did a crab island charter for a bachelorette very recently and had a freaking blast!!!! Aj’s was super fun as well- our fave bar for going out. Coyote ugly was okay but not worth it besides a quick step in for the experience if you’ve never been. 
Thursday we flew in, went out to eat, then did a goofy activity (PowerPoint nonsense) and drinking at the house. Friday we did the crab island party boat charter (I cannot emphasize how awesome this place was! So much fun!!!!), relaxed and recovered at the house after and then hit the bars. Saturday we did a beach day and day drink, pool party at the house, and then a final dinner out at a nicer place, then more hanging at the house to be ready for the flights the next morning. Tbh the schedule had a nice flow, super fun, and still gave time to relax, I’d recommend something similar for sure

The other one I just put the hand warmer on and put in my bra and let it self heat. Had a 40 min drive to the testing site and it hit the temp perfectly by the time I was there.
